newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kanematsu shares down on weaker earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Kanematsu shares down on weaker earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares of Kanematsu Corp dropped in Friday morning trade, depressed by the company's announcement on Thursday that it revised downward its earnings forecast for the 1996/97 business year.
As of 0028 GMT, the share price was down nine yen at 556. Trading volume was 2.72 million shares.
On Thursday, Kanematsu said it expected to write off 40 billion yen in the year ending March 31, 1997, due to losses on financial investments and the winding up of some affiliates.
The trading house also said it expected to post a parent net loss of 20 billion yen for 1996/97, against its previous forecast of a net profit of two billion yen.
